snippet.title: Chivalware | Reveal Trailer | Coming Autumn 2026
snippet.description:
Play Chivalware’s demo, available NOW on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3591900/Chivalware/ 

Chivalware is a fast-paced action roguelite where you fight on a grid battlefield. Dodge relentless enemy attacks while matching tiles to charge your weapons – the more tiles you match, the more times you can attack!

Blending real-time, rapid grid-based combat and deeply satisfying tile matching in a nonstop, dance-like battle, Chivalware will send you into the deepest flowstate like you’ve ever experienced.

Think you can handle it? Jump into the game’s debut demo on Steam today:
⚔️ Play the first of 5 playable characters - The Disk Knight
💾 34 out of 80 weapon disks to try
🔓 45 out of 150+ upgrades to unlock
🗺️ Explore the first out of four biomes and challenge its boss: The Tyrant 
💪 Test your skill in an additional difficulty level (the main game will have 5)

Stay tuned by following the game on socials:
X / Twitter - https://twitter.com/RegalPigeon 
Discord - https://discord.gg/Mkg9mb9z 

Animation by DeeDee Animation Studio: https://www.deedeestudio.net/en
Key Art by Massimo Di Leo: https://www.instagram.com/dileomax/
